hypothesis: Using the user-supplied Band-ZigZag default pivot stream, reverse after exactly N complete bars without a newer extreme: low -> long, high -> short. Sweep every integer N from 0 to 30.

research_provenance.source: User-supplied Trendoscope Band-Zigzag Pine, 2026-11-07; HeWhoMustNotBeNamed/ta/1 published source
research_provenance.implementation: Python port of default SMA20/Bollinger x2 sticky and adaptive pivot updates; Pine review uses original imports and pivot functions
research_provenance.scope: Default Bollinger/SMA20/sticky/adaptive only; other band and moving-average input combinations are not part of this run

mechanisms.description: Observe the latest provisional ZigZag endpoint, wait N completed bars without a newer extreme, then trade opposite to the completed leg

entry_design.direction: Latest low -> long; latest high -> short
entry_design.decision_time: At close of bar with age N; first fill at next bar open
entry_design.reset: A later high or low replacing the endpoint restarts the count; a new opposite pivot changes direction
entry_design.common_exit_rule: Opposite entry reverses the position; no other filter or exit

parameter_rationale: Every integer age 0..30 is tested, including requested 5, 10 and 30; 0 is an immediate unconfirmed endpoint control. No candle-direction, ratio or wick filter is added.
baseline: 25%-capital buy-and-hold per stock on the same candles and expense model
signal_rule: Port source Pine add_pivots under default BB20 SMA, multiplier 2, sticky=true, useAdaptive=true. Each completed bar records latest provisional pivot. At exact age N since its last replacement, issue long after a low or short after a high. Fill next bar open. New extreme resets age. Reverse on opposite qualifying signal.
signal_semantics: A plotted ZigZag endpoint is provisional and can move; historical label location is not the observation time. Event uses only the endpoint visible on the decision bar.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual backtest per stock, not a combined portfolio
execution_timing: Signal on confirmed bar close, execution on next open; no backdated fill at pivot price
rebalance_rule: At most one position per stock; opposite signal reverses
availability_lag: Only completed chart bars; 4H and 1W aggregated from completed source candles
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Compare all 31 preregistered delays, full-year and monthly outcomes, neighboring delays and identical buy-and-hold control. No automatic paper promotion before Pine/Python signal parity and user chart check.

untested_dependencies: Alternative bands and moving averages from source input menu

limitations: Pine strategy must still be compiled and trade-matched in TradingView
Corporate actions and short borrow are incomplete
User-supplied indicator has a provisional endpoint that may later extend
